general.notes: Solution uses paired modules SO-SFP-10GE-BX40D-2733 (footnote 1: Tx 1260–1280 nm, Rx 1320–1340 nm) and SO-SFP-10GE-BX40D-3327 (footnote 2: Tx 1320–1340 nm, Rx 1260–1280 nm). Nominal wavelength Tx/Rx: 1270nm/1330nm and 1330nm/1270nm. Power budget 4.5 – 16dB. Operating temperature also -40°C to +85°C for I-temp (-I) ordering options. Storage temperature -40°C to +85°C. Tx output and Rx min/overload are average power (footnote 3). Rx sensitivity and overload measured at 10.3Gbps, BER ≤ 1x10-12, PRBS 231-1, back-to-back (footnote 4). IEEE 802.3ae 10GBASE-ER/EW defined only at 1550 nm; standard cited for bridgeable distance only.
